verdict.rationale: CSC documents its own APIs: secure APIs for integrating service of process with ELM, claims and payroll systems, and "secure bi-directional integrations with enterprise and third-party systems via modern APIs" for entity management. Nothing shows that the API covers what the CSCNavigator UI does, such as Compliance Calendar, forms library, document generation and structure charts. Probes found no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, which suggests a partner-integration API rather than a parity API. missing for 10: evidence of API/UI feature parity, public API reference or OpenAPI spec, endpoint coverage of entity management, filings and document workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
